cases.input: Revise a chapter after a workshop identified a structural scene problem and local prose issues.
requiredBehaviors: revise in developmental then scene then line order
forbiddenBehaviors: polish sentences before resolving the structural issue

cases.input: The workshop recommends changing a memorable idiosyncratic sentence pattern, but it is listed as a protected strength.
requiredBehaviors: treat strength preservation as a hard review anchor
seek a revision that solves the issue without flattening voice
forbiddenBehaviors: normalize the voice for uniformity alone
skillAnchors: Keine stilistische Glättung nur zur Gleichförmigkeit

cases.input: A science narrative revision invents a new mechanism to improve drama.
requiredBehaviors: block invention of new scientific facts
route factual changes to the science evidence path
skillAnchors: Keine neuen Fakten in Science Writing
